delete_semantics.delete: HTTP DELETE removes the metadata component or row from the environment; it is destructive and is never a substitute for removing solution membership.
delete_semantics.remove_solution_component: RemoveSolutionComponent removes only the component's membership from the named unmanaged solution; it does not delete the component from the environment.

policy.mcp_solution_authoring_rationale: Generic Dataverse MCP writes do not provide a compiler-validated explicit custom-solution context equivalent to the operation's documented Web API solution mechanism; Dataverse MCP is discovery and targeted post-action verification only for solution-aware authoring.

add-solution-component.rationale: Use only for an already-existing component; creation with MSCRM.SolutionUniqueName remains the preferred documented mechanism.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact object ID is a member of only the routed custom solution among declared custom solutions.

admin-center-primary.rationale: Environment audit administration is not a custom-solution authoring operation.

verification.rationale: Verify only the configured audit scope after the administrator action.

connection-reference-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Query the exact connection-reference logical name without inspecting connection secrets.

connection-reference-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the connection-reference row and can break consumers; it is not membership removal.

verification.rationale: Confirm only the exact logical name was removed.

connection-reference-update.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify logical name, connector identity, and non-secret metadata only.

connection-reference-verify.rationale: Targeted verification does not inspect or bind a concrete connection.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact logical name and non-secret connector metadata.

copilot-studio-primary.rationale: Copilot Studio artifacts require the registered product-specific authoring resource; no generic Dataverse Web API authoring claim is made.

verification.rationale: Use targeted Dataverse grounding and published-agent verification only.

documented-flow-not-reliable.rationale: Workflow row CRUD is documented, but Microsoft does not document the complete cloud-flow clientdata construction contract required for safe compiler authoring.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact workflow identity and runtime outcome after supported visual authoring.

documented-form-not-reliable.rationale: SystemForm CRUD is documented, but the current required payload cannot safely construct or merge complete FormXml/FormJson and role/order dependencies.

verification.rationale: Verify exact form metadata after portal authoring.

environment-variable-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Query only the exact schema name and never expose a current or secret value.

environment-variable-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the definition and associated behavior in the environment; it is not membership removal.

verification.rationale: Confirm the exact definition no longer exists without reading values.

environment-variable-update.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify definition metadata by exact schema name without returning values.

environment-variable-verify.rationale: Targeted verification is safe when values and raw bodies are never logged.

verification.rationale: Read definition field names and status only; withhold all values.

maker-portal-primary.rationale: No documented compiler-reliable Web API payload contract is claimed for this component; the visual product authoring surface remains primary.

verification.rationale: Use targeted Dataverse reads after the human authoring step.

mcp-environment-primary.rationale: This component is environment-bound rather than solution-bound, so the explicit custom-solution Web API routing rule does not apply.

verification.rationale: Environment-bound records do not require custom-solution context.

metadata-choice-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact global choice name and values.

metadata-choice-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the global choice and never removes only solution membership.

verification.rationale: Confirm the exact global choice no longer exists.

metadata-choice-update.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact global choice values after action calls.

metadata-choice-verify.rationale: Targeted verification avoids broad metadata discovery.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact global choice.

metadata-column-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact table and column logical names.

metadata-column-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the column in the environment and never means solution-membership removal.

verification.rationale: Confirm only the canonical column was removed.

metadata-column-update.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Retrieve, merge, replace, publish, and verify the exact column definition.

metadata-column-verify.rationale: Targeted verification avoids broad table or solution inventory.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact column.

metadata-key-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact key schema name, columns, and index status.

metadata-key-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the alternate key and never removes only solution membership.

verification.rationale: Confirm the exact key no longer exists.

metadata-key-update-unsupported.rationale: Microsoft documents create and delete semantics for alternate keys; update is not treated as an in-place reliable operation and delete/create is never substituted automatically.

verification.rationale: Verify the replacement key only after an explicitly approved delete and create sequence.

metadata-key-verify.rationale: Targeted verification checks asynchronous key activation without broad discovery.

verification.rationale: Target-read only the containing table's key collection and match the canonical key name.

metadata-publish.rationale: PublishXml targets named entities or choices; PublishAllXml is prohibited.

verification.rationale: Re-read only the published canonical metadata.

metadata-relationship-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact relationship schema name.

metadata-relationship-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the relationship in the environment and never removes only solution membership.

verification.rationale: Confirm the exact relationship no longer exists.

metadata-relationship-update.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Retrieve and replace the one exact relationship definition.

metadata-relationship-verify.rationale: Targeted verification avoids broad metadata discovery.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact relationship.

metadata-table-create.rationale: Generic MCP writes do not guarantee the documented explicit custom-solution header; Web API is compiler-bound and MCP is verification-only.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact logical name and verify routed-solution membership.

metadata-table-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the table in the environment; it is never substituted for RemoveSolutionComponent.

verification.rationale: Confirm the exact table no longer exists; do not infer another identity.

metadata-table-update.rationale: A schema_table update is a compiler-owned extension of an existing table; every declared child column uses the documented solution header and MCP remains verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify only the exact existing table and child columns added by the compiler-owned extension payload.

metadata-table-verify.rationale: Web API or MCP targeted reads verify the result without solution export or unpack.

verification.rationale: Read the canonical table identity and exact expected fields only.

pac-primary.rationale: PAC remains primary only for its documented source, package, registration, and solution operations; generic component creation is not claimed.

verification.rationale: Use targeted Dataverse verification after supported PAC source, package, or registration operations.

power-bi-native.rationale: The component is a Power BI artifact and outside Dataverse Web API routing.

verification.rationale: Verify through the registered Power BI resources.

remove-solution-component.rationale: RemoveSolutionComponent changes membership only and must never be substituted for HTTP DELETE.

verification.rationale: Verify the component still exists but is no longer a member of the routed solution.

repository-native.rationale: The component is repository-only and outside Dataverse Web API routing.

verification.rationale: Use the component's native repository build and validation tools.

role-create.rationale: The executor creates the role at the root business unit under the documented solution header, then assigns each compiler-declared privilege by exact name and depth through the AddPrivilegesRole bound action; MCP stays verification-only.

verification.rationale: Read the exact role by name and confirm the declared privileges resolved and assigned at the requested depths.

role-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the role row in the environment; it is never substituted for RemoveSolutionComponent.

verification.rationale: Confirm only the exact role was removed.

role-update.rationale: The executor creates the role at the root business unit under the documented solution header, then assigns each compiler-declared privilege by exact name and depth through the AddPrivilegesRole bound action; MCP stays verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact role after the patch by name and re-confirm the declared privileges.

role-verify.rationale: Targeted verification reads only the exact role, not the full role inventory.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact role by name.

view-create.rationale: The executor generates FetchXML and LayoutXML from the structured view payload and writes the SavedQuery row under the documented solution header; MCP stays verification-only.

verification.rationale: Query the exact view by name, returned type, and query type to confirm the compiler-generated FetchXML and LayoutXML.

view-delete.rationale: HTTP DELETE destroys the SavedQuery row in the environment; it is never substituted for RemoveSolutionComponent.

verification.rationale: Confirm only the exact view was removed.

view-update.rationale: The executor generates FetchXML and LayoutXML from the structured view payload and writes the SavedQuery row under the documented solution header; MCP stays verification-only.

verification.rationale: Verify the exact view content after the patch by name and returned type.

view-verify.rationale: Targeted verification reads only the exact saved query, not the full view inventory.

verification.rationale: Target-read the exact view by name and returned type.
